description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for updating user information within the application. It contains data models, validation logic, and a request handler that processes user edit requests, updates user data in the database, and returns the updated user envelope.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Represents user data fields that can be edited, such as username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Encapsulates the user data for an edit request, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command object ensuring that user data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user edit request, updating the user's data in the database and returning the updated user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the edit command, updating user details in the database, handling password hashing, and returning the updated user information.
